desktop-fm.layout: The reference uses an almost empty field with one central disc and a small action window near the bottom. The object establishes identity; the window provides the task. Treat them as independently positioned layers rather than one flattened hero image.
components: Disc, laser paths and background form one media layer. Keep essential copy outside the effect.
A compact title, optional utility controls and one primary action. Its bounds should remain predictable while the scene moves.
A wide dark control within the window; use a distinct disabled/loading treatment for submission.
desktop-fm.color: Neutral gray is the visual ground; reflected silver and neon belong to the scene. Reserve high contrast for the action window and its control.
desktop-fm.type: Use a compact, heavy sans role for identity and actions, with a smaller supporting role. Confirm actual font loading before promoting a family.
desktop-fm.media: Keep a static disc poster and a lighter mobile scene. Scene materials should be a separate art-direction specification from ordinary UI colors.
desktop-fm.states: Verify scene loading/failure, keyboard access to the window, waiting-list feedback and a reduced-motion still state.

gt-planar.layout: An instrument-like strip spans the top of a full-screen graphic field. Navigation, warnings and specimen controls must remain legible while the background changes.
components: Rectangular grouped labels with consistent outline thickness and alignment.
The face being demonstrated should have explicit size, weight and text-input states.
Warp lines and instrument details form the media layer; they must not obscure navigation.
gt-planar.color: Use the black/white scene as the main field. Separate warning, action and specimen-highlight colors rather than calling all bright hues an accent.
gt-planar.type: Typography is both content and interface. Record the specimen face separately from small navigation and status text.
gt-planar.media: The reference supports a single warp-field state. Document rendering cost, load poster and contrast-safe control backgrounds before adapting it.
gt-planar.states: Verify text entry, specimen settings, focus outlines, scene pause and reduced-motion behavior.

hyper-tria.layout: The supplied state is a white portfolio spread: navigation above an image/copy pair, with an identity badge near the lower corner. Refero describes an additional chrome hero that is not pictured here.
components: Pair one dominant image with a controlled copy measure; maintain aligned edges.
Treat the circular mark as supplied art, with clear space and a static fallback if animated.
Keep current project and agency-level destinations distinguishable.
hyper-tria.color: The pictured white/black shell is distinct from the colored project rendering. Additional hero colors require a matching capture.
hyper-tria.type: Use a navigation role, an editorial project-description role and a supplied identity role. The pictured italic copy should not automatically become the universal body style.
hyper-tria.media: Preserve project image ratios and captions. Do not redraw the mark or promote image colors to brand tokens.
hyper-tria.states: Verify project selection, language navigation, long-copy wrapping and the unpictured hero transition.

evoke.layout: A repeated three-column work strip precedes a very large identity wordmark. The work tiles carry varied visual languages while the page frame remains simple.
components: A consistent slot for a project image, destination and accessible name; the project art may vary.
Define column count, gutter and overflow behavior rather than hard-coding one screenshot width.
Identity artwork has its own scale and crop rules.
evoke.color: Separate site colors from project-specific photography, illustration and licensed character art. A colorful tile is not evidence of a global interface role.
evoke.type: Use a stable small navigation/caption role around a dramatically larger identity role.
evoke.media: Image and illustration assets need attribution, aspect-ratio rules and fallback handling; a reference screenshot grants no reuse rights.
evoke.states: Verify work-tile focus/hover, captions, project detail navigation and how the wordmark scales on narrow screens.

superhi.layout: The centered message has a protected reading area surrounded by large asymmetrically cropped shapes. Navigation and paired actions use calmer, repeatable surfaces.
components: Choose a small vocabulary of circles, polygons and starbursts with placement and crop rules.
Set a controlled line length with a clear supporting paragraph.
Primary and secondary actions use distinct fills and a shared capsule grammar.
Keep transactional controls predictable even when the decoration changes.
superhi.color: Separate decorative shape colors from action and text roles. The reference's bright geometric layer should not compete with the CTA.
superhi.type: Large sans display text carries the statement; smaller supporting text and navigation provide continuity. The sampled live heading family is evidence for that viewport only.
superhi.media: Flat shapes can be vector assets with simple crop rules. Record any shape motion independently from hover and navigation transitions.
superhi.states: Verify the two actions, catalog navigation, offer-strip dismissal, shape reflow and reduced-motion behavior.

composer.layout: A faint structural grid supports a large headline and colored rectangular modules. Copy and the action sit on a stable left edge while the modules build a separate visual rhythm.
components: Define column and row alignment; the visual grid should not imply every module is interactive.
A bounded fill may support emphasis, pattern or media, with a declared purpose.
Large text needs line-break and overlap rules.
Separate product entry from editorial navigation.
composer.color: The reference uses several saturated blocks over a neutral field. Define which blocks communicate information and which are decorative.
composer.type: Use an oversized sans display role and a quieter UI role. Avoid shrinking the entire desktop display composition to fit mobile.
composer.media: A modular pattern should have a simple static form. Product imagery and charts require their own semantic labels and accessible explanations.
composer.states: Verify display wrapping, module overlap, primary action and whether any pattern animation conveys information.

programa.layout: The supplied screenshot has a centered serif introduction, floating material/object cards and a large product frame below. That composition differs from the source's more austere Swiss description.
components: Separate display serif, supporting copy and paired actions.
Small image-based accents should have consistent bounds and avoid obscuring text.
An application screenshot needs a caption or explanation when it demonstrates workflow.
programa.color: Use calm surfaces and reserve highlights for meaningful emphasis. Do not infer a full palette from product screenshots or material cards.
programa.type: The pictured serif display is a distinct role from navigation and product UI. A pure Swiss sans hierarchy is not established by this image.
programa.media: Product frames may have different rules from decorative cards. Keep both separate from real interactive application controls.
programa.states: Verify object movement, product-demo transitions, CTA focus and narrow-screen ordering before selecting this direction.

spacelab.layout: A narrow left index and a broad right story column create the main asymmetric grid. The heading and photograph share a strong content edge.
components: Category links need an active state, consistent alignment and a clear mobile replacement.
Heading, image and caption form one editorial unit.
Use large architectural imagery without decorative card chrome.
Keep contact/about distinct from content filters.
spacelab.color: White space and dark text form the main system. Project photographs supply most variation; a sparse accent should have a declared action role.
spacelab.type: A restrained sans hierarchy supports display, paragraph and index text. Current samples identify HelveticaNeue; no global scale is inferred.
spacelab.media: Use consistent architectural image ratios and meaningful descriptions; preserve the relationship between image and story context.
spacelab.states: Verify selected category, index focus, long heading wraps, story pagination and mobile rail collapse.

fora.layout: A strict mosaic divides identity, positioning, team, news and projects into independently useful cells. Color can establish a cell's role without extra card framing.
components: Declare permitted content types and a minimum useful height for each.
The large serif mark is supplied identity art with its own placement rules.
Allow variable copy length and a visible destination.
Pair a full-bleed photograph with a small section action or caption.
fora.color: Large terracotta and lilac panels work as section surfaces. Text and action contrast must be checked per surface rather than inherited indiscriminately.
fora.type: Keep the serif identity distinct from sans content and small navigation. This hybrid can use a Swiss grid without requiring exclusively sans identity.
fora.media: Images should fit declared cell ratios and preserve the intended crop at each breakpoint.
fora.states: Verify mosaic reordering, long news copy, focus states inside colored cells and image loading/failure.

frankys.layout: The older reference splits a large product viewer from a tight product grid and anchors purchase information below. Checkerboard imagery and pixel-like texture provide the historical arcade direction.
components: Image/3D/AR states belong to one media component with explicit controls.
Keep price, availability and add-to-cart treatment consistent.
Primary action and selected product information stay adjacent.
The marquee should have a readable, pausable/static form.
frankys.color: Separate cream/dark UI surfaces and buy/availability roles from checkerboard texture and colored products.
frankys.type: The reference's pixel-like lettering and current frankysDailySlab samples represent different evidence states. Choose the dated direction before mapping production font roles.
frankys.media: Provide a conventional image fallback for 3D/AR and keep product color choices usable without the immersive viewer.
frankys.states: Verify selected product, out-of-stock, cart feedback, 3D/AR entry, texture legibility and reduced-motion behavior.

olipop.layout: Campaign artwork occupies one half of a promotion while headline, copy and action occupy the other. Calmer product-card sections follow the expressive campaign.
components: Define image/copy proportions and a sensible stacked order.
Keep flavor, format, price and shopping action independent from promotional imagery.
A starburst or label has crop and text-length limits.
Shopping controls retain a stable grammar across campaigns.
olipop.color: Distinguish stable brand roles from seasonal hero and packaging colors. The vivid berry promotion should not redefine every interface surface.
olipop.type: Expressive rounded serif display type provides nostalgia, with a simpler supporting and commerce hierarchy.
olipop.media: Packaging and campaign imagery need text alternatives; preserve product information outside decorative artwork.
olipop.states: Verify campaign reflow, carousel navigation, flavor selection, cart feedback and text contrast over promotional colors.

little-amps.layout: A broad documentary media scene establishes the opening, followed by a ruled navigation strip. Warm framing makes the media and interface feel related.
components: One image/video with a reliable poster and readable identity overlay.
Group commerce, informational destinations and utilities without relying only on dividers.
Keep prices and options readable in the label typography.
Dates and categories can use the same metadata grammar.
little-amps.color: Warm framing and dark supporting text are separate from photographed wood, records and coffee. Image colors are not the whole UI palette.
little-amps.type: Use expressive serif display alongside compact monospace labels. Long copy needs a deliberate reading role.
little-amps.media: Documentary images should retain captions/context; moving media needs a still fallback and pause control where applicable.
little-amps.states: Verify overlay contrast, navigation focus, shop/cart states and narrow-screen navigation order.

mike-matas.layout: A small identity block and compact link list sit above large work images with generous empty space. The work, rather than ornamental interface elements, creates visual variation.
components: Name/date or introduction needs stable placement and text wrapping.
Quiet links must still expose focus and hover states.
Device mockups and screenshots form the main content unit.
Add enough caption/destination information to explain each image.
mike-matas.color: Keep the UI palette restrained and separate it from colors shown inside project screenshots.
mike-matas.type: A small, consistent hierarchy can carry identity, links and project descriptions; very thin text should be checked at real display sizes.
mike-matas.media: Large work images need loading, crop and aspect-ratio rules. Avoid flattening all project descriptions into image pixels.
mike-matas.states: Verify project destinations, keyboard order, image failure, captions and the spacing rhythm at narrow widths.

everlane.layout: Compact navigation and a centered identity frame full-width fashion photography. Promotion appears in a separate horizontal band, keeping its urgency distinct from the lookbook.
components: Separate category, search and account/cart utilities.
Set explicit safe areas for overlay text.
One offer with clear destinations and a bounded height.
Product imagery, names and price must remain usable without hover.
everlane.color: A restrained shell allows campaign imagery to dominate. Promotional hues should have a distinct temporary role.
everlane.type: Track short labels deliberately while keeping longer supporting text readable. Identity and product labels have different responsibilities.
everlane.media: Define crop/focal-point rules for people and apparel; preserve product details in text rather than relying on lifestyle images.
everlane.states: Verify search, category selection, product-card alternatives, cart feedback and contrast across changing hero photographs.

teenage-engineering.layout: The supplied state is an immersive product photograph rather than a catalog grid. The product and a conspicuous triangular consent panel are separate components with different purposes.
components: Give hardware imagery space without hiding the route to specifications or purchase.
Technical information needs a repeatable hierarchy independent from the hero.
A distinctive shape still requires clear settings and accept controls.
Compact controls should remain discoverable on media-heavy pages.
teenage-engineering.color: Separate product material/color, neutral interface roles and warning-like consent art. A yellow consent panel does not establish a universal brand accent.
teenage-engineering.type: Record the custom requested families as observations; do not adopt ultra-thin text without testing actual size and contrast.
teenage-engineering.media: A product scene needs a poster/fallback and a clear path to technical content. Photograph colors are art direction rather than CSS tokens.
teenage-engineering.states: Verify consent without changing it during research, product navigation, media loading, specifications and mobile discoverability.

slush.layout: A large display word acts as a foreground shape over a textured blue tube. Stickers sit above both; a conventional nav and paired actions preserve the task hierarchy.
components: Specify scale, line breaks and overlap regions.
A signature textured object is media, not a button surface.
Use bounded illustration sizes and avoid covering actions.
Pill controls retain conventional labels and consistent focus feedback.
slush.color: Keep saturated illustration colors distinct from semantic actions and status. High-contrast outlines connect stickers and controls visually.
slush.type: The massive condensed display role should not spread into body copy or controls. Supporting sans text needs a clear scale contrast.
slush.media: Raster/3D ribbon artwork and vector stickers need independent responsive rules and fallback assets.
slush.states: Verify display overlap, sticker placement, nav overflow, app-entry actions and reduced-motion/resting states.

steep.layout: A centered editorial statement is surrounded by detached charts, metric cards and a composer field. The fragments explain a product without requiring a full dashboard frame.
components: Serif display and selective italic emphasis need controlled wrapping.
Value, label, context and chart should remain a coherent unit.
Distinguish demonstration art from a real input.
Provide clear product-entry and demo-request priorities.
steep.color: A warm/glowing media ground and chart accents are separate from basic text/action surfaces. The screenshot's shadows need measurement before creating global elevation tokens.
steep.type: Pair an editorial serif display with practical sans labels and metrics. Preserve numeric readability and meaning.
steep.media: Chart fragments should have explanations and sensible static arrangements when animation is disabled.
steep.states: Verify demo versus interactive input, chart meaning, focus states, fragment reflow and actual shadow/glow values.

wise.layout: Heavy display text, a concise explanation and a small action group lead into a larger globe/media metaphor. Navigation occupies a compact band above.
components: Specify line breaks and minimum readable sizes for the heavy face.
A filled primary and quieter alternative need distinct roles.
The globe illustrates the message without becoming essential control chrome.
wise.color: The lime/dark pairing can provide identity through a small number of roles. Separate decorative globe colors from account/action and feedback colors.
wise.type: Use the heavy display face sparingly; supporting copy and functional controls need a less emphatic hierarchy.
wise.media: A globe scene should have a still fallback. Its implied service coverage is content, not a design-system claim.
wise.states: Verify region differences, light/dark surface inversion, action focus and media pause. Account/financial behavior is outside this study.

cursor.layout: A restrained introduction precedes a large product-window image over a painterly field. The marketing shell and the depicted application have distinct component vocabularies.
components: Keep one primary message and bounded supporting copy.
Download and demo/contact roles need a clear hierarchy.
Use a repeatable frame and caption for the working application.
Painterly scenery supports the product image rather than UI controls.
cursor.color: Warm neutral marketing surfaces should not be confused with syntax colors or application statuses inside screenshots.
cursor.type: Map marketing headline/body/labels separately from the application's code and editorial content; confirm actual font roles from source.
cursor.media: Window frames may overlap, but their key content should remain readable. Provide a simpler product still on narrow screens.
cursor.states: Verify platform download labels, product-demo motion, foreground/background contrast and which radius rules belong to each surface.

notion.layout: A product message and actions occupy the center; illustrated faces and doodled objects add personality around the edges. A large product example follows.
components: Define line, fill, scale and safe placement rules.
A colored emphasis capsule should be separate from an actionable button.
Signup and demo actions retain ordinary controls.
Screenshot content needs explanation independent from decorative figures.
notion.color: Use selective illustration and highlight fills rather than giving every control a hand-drawn treatment. Keep action roles consistent.
notion.type: Use a clear sans hierarchy for product copy and controls; illustration lettering belongs to artwork rather than the general reading system.
notion.media: Illustration and product screenshots have separate ownership and accessibility needs. Drawn styling does not establish how an asset was produced.
notion.states: Verify rotating emphasis, illustration movement, signup/demo focus, screenshot scaling and reduced-motion behavior.

neobrutalism-components.layout: A practical component-library shell combines navigation/search with a large introductory statement and example controls. The repeated border/shadow recipe is more important than a one-off hero scene.
components: A bordered, hard-shadowed surface with explicit hover, pressed, disabled and focus states.
A compact command/search trigger that exposes a predictable dialog or input.
Apply the same edge grammar without making every card interactive.
Preserve chart labels and semantic colors while using the surrounding border language.
neobrutalism-components.color: Bright fills and dark outlines should have separate semantic roles. State colors must remain understandable beyond the aesthetic.
neobrutalism-components.type: Current samples request DM Sans. Use a clear display/body/label hierarchy instead of assuming thick outlines require novelty type.
neobrutalism-components.media: Geometric star/shape assets can support identity, but should not replace labels or status indicators.
neobrutalism-components.states: Verify pressed shadow displacement, focus rings, disabled appearance, dark-mode contrast and chart keyboard/reading alternatives.

gumroad.layout: The current sample establishes large Favorit headings and a commercial navigation structure. It does not establish the old pink/yellow hard-shadow system often shown in historical examples.
components: Large display copy with one primary selling action.
A real search control needs results, empty and error states.
Keep creator identity, product information and action separate.
Pricing, feature discovery and account entry need clear roles.
gumroad.color: Do not import historical pink/yellow values as current brand roles without a matching source state.
gumroad.type: ABC Favorit is observed in current heading samples. Other roles remain unconfirmed.
gumroad.media: Creator illustrations and product art should be separated from permanent interface assets.
gumroad.states: Verify current control borders/shadows, search feedback and cart/account entry before classifying the current site as Neo-Brutalism.

excalidraw.layout: The working canvas is the main content surface, with tool controls and property settings around it. The sketch aesthetic belongs mainly to the drawing output.
components: Selection, drawing and viewport movement are distinct interaction modes.
Active tool and shortcuts must remain understandable without drawn decoration.
Stroke, fill, text and geometry settings need consistent feedback.
Save/export/share actions require clear scope and destination.
excalidraw.color: Separate drawing colors from tool selection, focus and error roles. A user's canvas palette is not the application brand palette.
excalidraw.type: Keep handwriting/sketch text options distinct from ordinary interface labels. The sampled default Times heading is not treated as a brand role.
excalidraw.media: Drawing primitives, rendered output and UI controls are separate artifacts; preserve editability and meaningful export choices.
excalidraw.states: Verify selection, undo, text entry, zoom, export and collaboration in a dedicated interaction pass. No canvas content was changed in this review.

roughjs.layout: A documentation page introduces the library, then demonstrates geometric primitives and fill styles. Its conventional website shell differs from the generated sketch output.
components: Line, polygon, ellipse and path output need stable parameters.
Hatching, solid and other patterns should have independent spacing/weight rules.
Pair a rendered result with concise explanatory code.
Keep API destinations distinct from sponsorship/project links.
roughjs.color: Drawing colors are input parameters, not a site-wide semantic palette. Specify stroke and fill independently.
roughjs.type: The documentation's sans typography is separate from any sketch-like lettering an application adds.
roughjs.media: Treat roughness, bowing, hatch gap and stroke width as drawing-system parameters. Canvas and SVG output have different accessibility/editing implications.
roughjs.states: Verify deterministic rendering where required, small-scale legibility, pattern density and the consuming application's interaction states.
